text:
Rachel: Quick review: built a compact notify preview for the alerting page. Goal: surface which channels will fire for a given threshold without scrolling. Prototype: https://figma.com/file/compact-preview

Anya: Looks promising. Two immediate concerns: keyboard tab order and translated labels overflowing on narrow widths.

Diego: For tab order, avoid relying on visual wrapping. If we use flex-wrap the DOM order can stray from visual order. Grid with explicit cells keeps order predictable.

Priya: Truncation plan: show ellipses for long names, expose full name in a tooltip and via `aria-describedby` so screen readers can read the full label.

Rachel: Good. Also copy question: preview uses "Turn off" vs product uses "Disable" in other places. Which should we standardize on?

Anya: Product prefers "Disable" for global actions, "Snooze" for temporal suppression. Change preview button to "Snooze" when it's a timeout-based action.

Diego: Accessibility: when a user triggers snooze from the preview we need an announcement. Use a focused, short live region for user actions: e.g., "Snoozed PagerDuty for 30 minutes". Don't announce full list changes while virtualizing.

Priya: Also ensure each pill has role="button" and aria-pressed for toggled state. If a channel is suppressed by routing logic instead of user action, aria-label should reflect that: "Email — suppressed by schedule".

Rachel: Visual design: I used a faint strikethrough plus a tiny tag for suppressed channels. Is that accessible enough?

Anya: Strikethrough alone is weak. Keep the tag ("Suppressed") and add an offscreen description for SR. Also ensure color + text meet 4.5:1 contrast.

Diego: We'll add a runtime contrast check utility that picks best foreground color for custom channel colors. If contrast fails, show a 1px border instead.

Priya: Keyboard flow: opening the suppression editor from a pill should move focus into the dialog to the first control. Escape closes and returns focus to the pill. Add a focus trap.

Rachel: Good call. Also, when a threshold slider updates preview results frequently, we should debounce updates to avoid spamming SR with many live updates. Final state announcement only when user stops moving the slider.

Diego: Implementation note: virtualization + aria-live can cause phantom announcements because nodes are recycled. Keep a dedicated live region separate from the list DOM and only write user-initiated messages to it.

Priya: Edge case: translations like German can push channel names very long. Make sure truncation and tooltip behavior works for RTL too.

Anya: UX nit: add a small "Preview status" pill at the top summarizing effective recipients, e.g., "Notifying: Email, Slack (suppressed)". That helps debugging instead of scanning each row. Ensure SR reads that summary first.

Rachel: Also copy: think we should change the hover state of pills from a color invert to an outline to avoid changing contrast ratios. Agree?

Diego: Outline is safer for contrast stability. We'll prototype both.

Priya: a11y-bot: checklist: logical DOM order, role+aria-pressed, aria-label includes status, user-action live region, debounce live updates, focus management for editor, contrast >= 4.5:1, tooltip + aria-describedby for full names, run axe + NVDA pass.

Rachel: Thanks. I'll update the mock: grid layout, summary pill, snooze copy, and add offscreen descriptions. Posting updated link in ~1h.

Anya: I'll pair on the DOM reorder PR tomorrow.
